name: copy-design
description: Recreate a website's visible design and interactions from a reference URL through responsive inspection and iterative comparison.

interface.longDescription: Recreate a website's visible design in your project from a reference URL. Inspect the reference across desktop and mobile layouts, map its sections, typography, spacing, colors, components, and interactions, then compare screenshots and refine the implementation. Reports inaccessible behavior and asset limitations clearly. Does not require an MCP connection.
defaultPrompt: Use $copy-design to recreate a website from its URL.
